sections.title: About S-Game (Developer)
sections.content:
S-Game (full name: 北京灵游坊科技有限公司, Beijing S-Game Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese game development studio based in Beijing.

Studio History

  • Founded: 2011
  • Previous titles: Phantom Blade (影之刃) series on mobile, Phantom Blade 2
  • Phantom Blade Zero is their first AAA console/PC title
  • Team size: ~100+ developers

Chinese Name

The Chinese name for Phantom Blade Zero is 影之刃零 (Yǐng zhī Rèn Líng), literally translating to "Shadow Blade Zero." The franchise name 影之刃 means "Shadow's Blade."

S-Game has been developing the Phantom Blade franchise for over a decade, starting with mobile games before expanding to this AAA console/PC release.

sections.title: Game Overview
sections.content:
Phantom Blade Zero is a martial arts action RPG set in a dark fantasy world inspired by Chinese wuxia (武侠) culture — the genre of wandering martial heroes.

Core Features

  • Fast-paced combat — inspired by character action games like Devil May Cry and Ninja Gaiden
  • The Shachi system — unique weapon switching mechanic for dynamic combos
  • 66-day countdown — narrative time pressure driving the story
  • 4 playable characters — Soul, Mu Xiaokui, Zuo Shang, The Chord
  • Dark wuxia world — Chinese martial arts fantasy with supernatural elements

Combat System

The game combines real-time action combat with deep weapon customization. Players can equip multiple weapons and switch between them mid-combo using the Shachi system.

💡 Key Differentiator: Unlike most action RPGs, Phantom Blade Zero lets you carry multiple weapon types simultaneously and chain them into continuous combos — similar to Devil May Cry's weapon switching but with Chinese martial arts flavor.

sections.title: Phantom Blade Series History
sections.content:
Phantom Blade Zero is the latest entry in the Phantom Blade (影之刃) franchise, but it's designed as a standalone game — no prior knowledge needed.

GameYearPlatformType
Phantom Blade (影之刃)2014iOS / AndroidMobile action RPG
Phantom Blade 2 (影之刃2)2017iOS / AndroidMobile action RPG
Phantom Blade Zero (影之刃零)TBAPC / PS5AAA Action RPG

📌 Note: Phantom Blade Zero is NOT a sequel to Phantom Blade 2. It's a complete reboot designed for console/PC with a new story, new characters, and Unreal Engine 5 graphics.

sections.title: Platforms & Release Status
sections.content:
Confirmed Platforms

  • PC — via Steam
  • PlayStation 5 — confirmed console exclusive launch partner

Release Date Status

⚠️ Not yet released. The game is scheduled to release on October 29, 2026.

Based on public information:

  • Multiple gameplay demos have been shown at gaming events (Gamescom, TGS)
  • The game is described as being in "late development" by the studio
  • No official release window has been announced as of September 2026

Will it come to Xbox?

Xbox release has not been confirmed. The PS5 partnership suggests a potential timed exclusive, but S-Game has not ruled out other platforms.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.content:
What country is Phantom Blade Zero from?

Phantom Blade Zero is developed by S-Game, a Chinese studio based in Beijing, China. The game draws heavily from Chinese wuxia (martial arts) culture and mythology.

What is the Chinese name of Phantom Blade Zero?

The Chinese name is 影之刃零 (Yǐng zhī Rèn Líng), meaning "Shadow Blade Zero."

Who created Phantom Blade Zero?

The game is created by S-Game (北京灵游坊科技), founded in 2011. They previously developed the Phantom Blade mobile series before making this AAA console/PC title.

Is Phantom Blade Zero multiplayer?

No. Phantom Blade Zero is a single-player action RPG. There are no confirmed multiplayer or online features.

Do I need to play previous Phantom Blade games?

No. Phantom Blade Zero is a standalone game with its own story and characters. Previous mobile games are set in a different timeline.
